name: PolyDrive
description: Self-hosted storage solution built in Go to explore direct file transfer architecture, custom storage drivers, and resilient data infrastructure.
short_problem: Direct file transfer and self-hosted storage system handling resilient data synchronization.
what_learned: Explored low-level stream handling in Go, POSIX filesystem abstractions, and chunked transfer encoding.
reason_for_making: Built to understand how self-hosted storage systems handle large file streaming and direct peer-to-peer data synchronization safely.

name: LocalDrop
description: High-speed local file transfer tool written in Rust exploring device-to-device zero-config networking, UDP discovery, and encrypted socket streams.
short_problem: High-speed local file transfer across devices without external internet or third-party cloud servers.
why_not_live: In initial prototyping and networking architecture phase.
what_learned: Exploring zero-copy socket transfers and cross-platform network interface discovery in Rust.
reason_for_making: Built to experiment with low-level networking primitives and high-throughput local peer-to-peer file transfers.

name: Stream
description: Experimental media platform built to explore media file ingestion, Telegram bot interfaces, metadata extraction, FFmpeg multi-bitrate transcoding, and scalable streaming pipelines.
short_problem: End-to-end media pipeline handling ingestion, automated metadata extraction, transcoding, and streaming.
what_learned: Explored how media files transition through ingestion, storage, metadata extraction, duplicate detection, and transcoding in distributed pipeline architectures.
reason_for_making: Centralizing a media collection into a custom streaming pipeline to understand media engineering.

related_articles.title: Building a Media Platform from Scratch

name: CodeAtlas
description: Static AST-powered code graph platform that parses source code, analyzes relationships between files, classes, and functions, and visualizes complex repository structures.
short_problem: Parsing static AST graphs to analyze relationships between files, functions, and classes in large repositories.
what_learned: Learned how static AST analysis extracts structural relationships from source code to render interactive dependency graphs.
reason_for_making: Built to accelerate repository onboarding by visualizing architecture and symbol relationships.

name: Cognidesk
description: Knowledge retrieval and organization platform exploring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (Qdrant), and microservice AI pipelines.
short_problem: RAG vector retrieval pipeline unifying fragmented research notes into a searchable AI knowledge system.
what_learned: Explored vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and RAG retrieval pipelines connecting LLMs to custom knowledge repositories.
reason_for_making: Built to unify fragmented notes into a searchable AI-assisted knowledge system.
